name: endoflife.date (product release cycles and end-of-life dates)
tier_rationale: Well-known community project with an identifiable maintainer group, public documentation, an open data licence (MIT) and several years of public track record (A8 community); P187 cond 5 'Registry provider endoflife: tier community (dataset source)'.

reliability.justification: Community-maintained release calendars sourced from vendor announcements; dates are usually right but may lag a vendor change.

products.title: endoflife.date API v1 /api/v1/products/{slug} (weekly datasets endoflife.<slug> for the pinned mapping v3lum/data/endoflife/eol_products.json)

terms.quote: One grouped finding per asset lists all EOL components: medium/low on own or in-scope assets (org_profile), info on third-party or attacker infrastructure (CDN/SaaS edges are context). Attribution: endoflife.date (MIT data). Registry provider endoflife: tier community (dataset source).

products.notes: Quote: binding council text (P187 cond 5); research C0440 'MIT (data)', verified live 2026-11-26 (Netlify, no rate-limit headers, 0.2 s per product, schema_version 1.2.x; an unknown slug answers a 404 HTML page). Dataset source only (datasets endoflife.<slug>, one per pinned slug; P187 cond 1): one weekly dataset per pinned slug, fetched by `v3lum data update`, never during a scan, so the investigated stack is never disclosed. Read offline by the correlation rule g08_endoflife.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G08-1 (P187 endoflife: registered datasets + correlation rule, no per-scan request; module tier n/a, terms open).
